title: ID0420469-DC/Si-D/AT-[ Y2 / S5 313693895001 ] FW Update
description:
Reported issue: I only want to know if there is a way to search for the EcoG-FW version in the Logs. Our customer wants to know if the Charger has already EcoG´s with 1.4.11. I know the Charger must be updated, this will happen soon. but how do i know on which FW the EcoG are. May you can say me at which SiD-FW version the EcoGs gets an update.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420469-DC/Si-D/AT-[ Y2 / S5 313693895001 ] Wants to know FW version CRM:02684000149
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel,
Thank you for the update. We will perform the charger update during the time slots you shared:
07:00 to 13:00 and 15:30 to 18:30 (UTC+02:00)
.
Since charger Y2 / S5 - 313693895001 is currently on version v3.2.8, we will need to update it step-by-step:
v3.2.8 → v4.0.11 → v5.0.23 → v6.1.3 (latest).
The update will be done remotely and will require a significant amount of data. Please ensure that the SIM in Router 1 has a sufficient data plan, at least 15 GB is recommended.
Additionally, is this the only charger that needs to be updated, or are there others as well?
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
